question: Which additional seed-mantra forms are attributed to the goddess Kālī?
premises: Kālī is described as having the form of the māyā seed.
She is also described as having the form of the kūrca seed.
inference: The goddess is identified with the māyā and kūrca seed-mantras.
plain_english: She is of the nature of the māyā seed and of the nature of the kūrca seed.
